faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a1: Our standard MOQ starts from one 20-foot container, with larger volumes available for regular buyers. Contact us for a quotation tailored to your needs.
faq.a2: We accept Telegraphic Transfer (T/T), typically structured as a partial advance payment with the balance settled before or upon shipment.
faq.a3: We ship under Freight On Board (FOB) terms from Indonesian ports, and can coordinate CIF arrangements for select destinations upon request.
faq.q4: Can I request a product sample?
faq.a4: Yes, samples can be arranged for serious buyers. Please contact us via WhatsApp or the form below to discuss sample requests.
faq.q5: Do you provide complete export documentation?
faq.a5: Yes. Every shipment includes a Phytosanitary Certificate, Certificate of Origin, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and Bill of Lading.
faq.a6: We maintain a stable supply capacity of approximately 2,800 tons per month across our export markets.
faq.q7: Which countries do you currently export to?
faq.a7: We currently export to Thailand, China, and India, with quality and packaging tailored to each market's requirements.
faq.q8: How can I place an order?
faq.a8: Reach out via WhatsApp or our contact form with your requirements, and our team will guide you through quotation, sampling, and shipment scheduling.
